allowed: Connect to a backend you are entitled to use under its own terms and model licenses.
Check the actual backend, region, plan, and route before using programmatic or agent workflows.
forbidden: Do not treat OpenAI wire compatibility or local hosting as a grant of service, model-license, or data-use rights.
Do not bypass the backend's access controls, quotas, or applicable use restrictions.
retention: Backend-specific: this transport has no retention policy of its own. Local software, remote gateways, and upstream models can have different logging and storage settings.
training: Backend-specific: compatibility with an API does not establish whether a service trains on your content. Review its current terms and privacy settings.
